description: Source code defining classes and types for analogue gauge widgets in a dashboard application, including gauge configuration, rendering, and update logic.

classes.name: BaseGaugeModel
classes.description: Extends CanvasGauges.BaseGauge with optional _value property for gauge state.

classes.name: TbBaseGauge
classes.description: Abstract class providing gauge creation, update, resize, and destroy functionalities for widget gauges.

classes.name: TbAnalogueGauge
classes.description: Abstract class extending TbBaseGauge, specialized for analogue gauges with configuration and rendering logic.

methods.name: createGaugeOptions
methods.description: Abstract method to create gauge options based on DOM element and settings.

methods.name: createGauge
methods.description: Abstract method to instantiate gauge object with given options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates gauge value based on latest widget data, applying formatting if needed.

methods.name: mobileModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts gauge animation based on mobile mode status.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes gauge to match widget container dimensions.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys gauge instance and cleans up resources.

methods.name: createGaugeOptions
methods.description: Creates configuration object for the gauge, including min/max values, ticks, colors, fonts, highlights, and animation settings.

methods.name: prepareGaugeOptions
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to further customize gauge options.
